This paper should be considered a first step to solve Problem 3, i.e., the case that we do not know the values of the Fourier transform, but only the absolute value of it. In small-angle X-ray scattering and partly also in wide-angle X-ray scattering one can detect the absolute value of the Fourier transform on a sphere, the Ewald sphere, see e.g. [1,22]. Therefore uniqueness questions and phase retrieval algorithms are important subjects for application in crystallography and other domains.
